title: Celebrating AMP® T2D
summary: The Knowledge Portal team is proud to have been a part of the Accelerating Medicines Partnership® Program – Type 2 Diabetes!
bodyHtml:
The Accelerating Medicines Partnership® Program – Type 2 Diabetes, which supported the development of the Type 2 Diabetes Knowledge Portal, successfully concluded in December 2021. The Knowledge Portal team is proud to have been a part of this effort and excited to participate in the program's expansion to AMP® Common Metabolic Diseases.
